Review README.md and /src files for repository purpose/structure and update this overview accordingly.

**Stack:** .NET 10.0 (`net10.0`), latest C#, nullable and implicit usings enabled, warnings as errors (`TreatWarningsAsErrors=true`). XML warning 1591 is suppressed via `NoWarn`. All projects inherit [Directory.Build.props](Directory.Build.props). Central package management is enabled (`ManagePackageVersionsCentrally=true`); versions belong in [Directory.Packages.props](Directory.Packages.props), and `.csproj` references omit versions. Add packages with `<PackageVersion Include="PackageName" Version="x.y.z" />`.

**Layout:** `src/` production, `tests/` tests, `Directory.Build.props`, `Directory.Packages.props`, `Template.slnx`.

**C# style:** File-scoped namespaces outside namespace (`namespace MyProject.Feature;`), not `namespace MyProject.Feature`; 2-space indentation, CRLF, UTF-8 BOM, Allman braces, braces except single-line exits, `csharp_prefer_braces = true`, and `csharp_new_line_before_open_brace = all`. Underscore camelCase private fields; PascalCase constants; `var` for built-ins/apparent types; `I` interfaces; `Async` async suffix. Prefer primary constructors, always assigning readonly fields; top-level entry points; pattern matching; expression-bodied properties/indexers/accessors, but NOT methods. Run `dotnet format`. Use analyzers from [Directory.Build.props](Directory.Build.props); consider NSDepCop. See [.editorconfig](.editorconfig).

**Configuration/logging/security:** Use `appsettings.json`, `appsettings.{Environment}.json`, `IConfiguration`, `IOptions<T>`, strongly typed settings, and User Secrets for development. Never hardcode sensitive information in source code. Use `Microsoft.Extensions.Logging`, appropriate levels (`Trace`, `Debug`, `Information`, `Warning`, `Error`, `Critical`), context, structured logging, and correlation IDs when possible; avoid sensitive data. Use `Ardalis.GuardClauses` for non-UI validation and prefer `FluentValidation` for complex/UI validation. UI invalid input gets user-friendly errors; non-UI invalid input throws appropriate guard-clause exceptions. Return suitable HTTP status codes. Follow OWASP; validate/sanitize inputs; parameterized queries/ORM; authentication/authorization; HTTPS.

**Design:** Unit-testable, focused classes/methods (ideally under 20 lines), DI, composition over inheritance, async I/O, short argument lists (parameter objects over 4), FastEndpoints `REPR`, DDD where applicable. API messages use `*Request`/`*Response`; use cases `*Command`/`*Query`; DTOs between layers, never expose domain entities; `*Details`/`*Summary`; keep interfaces and implementations in separate projects.

**Tests:** Offer to add applicable business-logic tests in `tests/`; only test controlled code, not framework code. New production projects go in `src/`, tests in `tests/`; test projects use `xUnit`. Use `xUnit`, Arrange-Act-Assert with whitespace only, mirrored feature folders, and separate unit/integration projects or folders. Do not name test classes with "Tests" suffix; use "Tests" suffix for folders if needed. Example: `ProductServiceTests/ProductService_Constructor.cs`. Use `[Fact]`, `[Theory]`/`[InlineData]`; class names `ClassName_MethodName.cs`; methods `DoesSomething_GivenSomeCondition`, forming a proper sentence. Example `ProductService_Constructor._ReturnsInstanceGivenValidInputs`. Prefer NSubstitute and Shouldly; avoid commercially licensed testing libraries (e.g. FluentAssertions, Moq).

`dotnet run --project src/YourProject/YourProject.csproj`

**Docs:** Markdown only; headings; syntax-highlighted snippets; run linting; blank lines before/after lists and code listings.

[.gitignore](.gitignore) uses standard Visual Studio ignore patterns.
